caption: The drawing depicts a greenish-bronze figurine of a horse standing on top of a vertically-oriented, spiral-twisted cylindrical pedestal, which itself rests on a circular base. The horse has a simple, stylized form with four legs, a short tail, and pointed ears, and it supports a long, flat, elliptical object balanced on its back, pointed at an upward diagonal angle. The pedestal beneath the horse features a prominent helical groove running down its length, and the surface of the entire object has a patina with various shades of green and hints of brown, giving a sense of aged metal. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige color. The artist's name, "Stanley Mazur," is written in small print at the bottom right.
title: Shoe Shine Foot Rest
